Shilshole Ave

Newer & Improved?

Tired of drinking in a 120 year old load zone? How about a 100 year old garage instead! Comes standard with a covered outdoor beer garden (that’s well heated!), picnic tables, plants, and the occasional sunburn.

AND NOW ALL AGES ARE WELCOME AT THIS LOCATION. KIDS AND BABIES OK!

Parking & Bus Stops

There is plenty of street parking along Shilshole – just make sure you are not blocking a garage or driveway. The bus routes that stop on Market are 17, 18, 29, 40, & 44. The D line is nearby as well, on 15th Ave NW.
